history_phase_profile.scope: Generated valid 26 MB metadata fixture. Current production exact Delete, HTTP request/history wrappers, atomic save, backend inventory/preview/cleaning-tab response construction. Excludes socket scheduling, browser rendering, Windows filesystem and antivirus. No 550M-point or user-machine performance claim.
history_phase_profile.refresh_note: Current JobUI multiAction waits with skipSync and performs one final JobUI.sync. That fetches compact /api/job inventory and invalidated preview. The general app poll also refreshes SurfaceUI; its full cluster response is reported separately, not charged to the direct Delete quick path.
history_phase_profile.stage_note: atomic_save_seconds is included in edit_seconds. snapshot_seconds + equality_seconds + edit_seconds approximate total Delete time. Shared-host timing variation remains visible; only the removed snapshot/serialization work is deterministic.
history_phase_profile.undo_redo_scope: Direct history.apply restoration, cache validation and atomic save; excludes the outer HTTP request wrapper. These restoration algorithms are unchanged.

installer_transactions.scope: Installer activation checks on Linux. Includes complete preservation and backup of a >20 MB existing project.json, rejection of nonisolated/existing self-check workspaces, and activation refusal on startup-check failure. No native Windows runtime claim.

isolated_startup.fixture_data: Synthetic metadata only; no scan points or user project paths.
isolated_startup.scope: The same oversized-metadata self-check body used before installer activation, executed on Linux with the matching dependency runtime. Native Windows execution occurs when the installer runs on Windows.

Generated bolt/lining/recess and SMRG fixtures verify specified geometry, not universal hardware recognition.
Linux Chromium/software WebGL interface checks do not establish native Windows/WebView2/GPU/dialog/DPI behaviour.
